# Maven Wrapper JAR
# This file is required for the Maven Wrapper to work. It is a binary file and should be downloaded from the official Maven Wrapper repository.
# Download URL: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/takari/maven-wrapper/3.3.9/maven-wrapper-3.3.9.jar
# Place the downloaded file at: backend/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar
